cheonaek.name: Cheonaek (The Star of Hardship)
cheonaek.description: Growing into a greater person through early trials. It involves wisely overcoming hardships to forge a solid self.

cheonbok.name: Cheonbok (The Star of Blessings)
cheonbok.description: Symbolizes heavenly blessings and material abundance. It is a fortunate energy where an honest effort leads to a comfortable life and prosperity.

cheongan.name: Cheongan (The Star of Strategy)
cheongan.description: Symbolizes extraordinary mental agility and judgment. It is the energy of a strategist who wisely solves complex problems to achieve goals.

cheongo.name: Cheongo (The Star of Solitude)
cheongo.description: Symbolizes noble bearing and an independent spirit. It exercises the most powerful reflective force when alone, walking its own path.

cheongwi.name: Cheongwi (The Noble Star)
cheongwi.description: Natural elegance and an energy that commands respect. It symbolizes a noble path and a pursuit of honor.

cheongwon.name: Cheongwon (The Star of Authority)
cheongwon.description: Symbolizes command over others and powerful charisma. It is the energy of a leader exercising authority at the center of an organization.

cheonin.name: Cheonin (The Star of Tenacity)
cheonin.description: Symbolizes insight as sharp as a blade and persistent endurance. It is the energy of powerful execution that completes difficult tasks to the end.

cheonmun.name: Cheonmun (The Star of Literacy)
cheonmun.description: Energy that combines academic depth and literary talent. Through deep contemplation, it realizes the truths of the world and spreads knowledge.

cheonpa.name: Cheonpa (The Star of Breakthrough)
cheonpa.description: A powerful force of destruction and creation that breaks existing molds to pave new paths. It cultivates innovation through constant challenge.

cheonsu.name: Cheonsu (The Star of Longevity)
cheonsu.description: Symbolizes unchanging vitality and calm patience over time. It lives a long, healthy life by valuing every moment without hurrying.

cheonye.name: Cheonye (The Star of Artistry)
cheonye.description: Symbolizes versatile skills and rich artistic sensibility. It breathes beautiful inspiration into the world with its own original sense.

cheonyeok.name: Cheonyeok (The Star of Movement)
cheonyeok.description: A dynamic energy that moves across the wide world instead of staying in one place. It expands life’s horizons by experiencing various places and environments.
